svg.aria-label: How much does a leaky split lie? Several photos of the same mole: split by image, some land in validation and the model has seen that mole before. Validation 0.853, test 0.716. Split by lesion, all photos of a mole stay on one side: validation 0.779, test 0.731. Means of three seeds.

svg.text: A STUDY ON HAM10000 SKIN-LESION PHOTOS
Many moles were photographed more than once.
Split the photos at random and the model gets
quizzed on moles it has already studied.
EfficientNet-B0 · official ISIC 2018 test set · mean of 3 seeds
the model has seen this mole
every photo of a mole on one side
